Investigation policy adds bounded code-mode stages: acquire independent known reads, stop for semantic judgment, and after inspecting evidence sequentially record findings, typed summary and explicit proposal in one exec using validated returned IDs. Stop on uncertain/error replies, preserve original operation keys/receipts, retain citations/limits and budget for final user explanation. No automatic replay, budget increase, new tool or authority. Existing real-code-host composition test proves viability, not generated compliance.
